task.title: Follow a setting deep link
task.shortdesc: Follow focused links between search, All settings, Guided context, and JSON locations.

prereq.p: A link or search result points to a setting, review state, raw key, deprecated item, or JSON location.

context.p: Deep links preserve orientation by opening the right editor and focusing the relevant setting or raw location.

step.cmd: Open the focused link from search, review, comparison, Guided, or JSON context.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Confirm the destination editor and focused setting or state.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Use the detail panel, filter, or JSON location to complete the task.

info.p: Expected result: the All settings profile remains focused on the selected task.

step.cmd: Return to the previous surface only after saving or discarding changes deliberately.

info.note: Changing settings can affect the exported Firefox policy. Review source, validation, and schema support before saving.

result.p: The linked setting opens in the correct surface with focus preserved.

postreq.p: Recovery: if the link cannot resolve, search by exact policy ID, preference key, or raw path.
